Callout.Name: Burns to the Face
Callout.Message: Person with facial burns from a gas ring.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, burns to face and hands, eyes closed.
Callout.Patient: I cannot open my eyes. Say something so I know where you are.

Lines.Approach: Face and hands and his eyes are shut. Do not let him touch them.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
